reviews.comment: She was great! She does not do tests and the class is very interesting. There is a field trip and honestly, it was so much fun. Dr.Morris cares a lot about her students and she is always willing to answer questions! I 10/10 recommend.

One of my favorite professors/courses during my time here! You can tell Dr. Morris is passionate on this subject and I learned much more than I initially expected to. Class majorly participation based with peer reflections, but the smaller class size makes it feel more approachable. Overall, a great course to take if your interested in the topic.

This class was very doable work wise, no tests and no textbook required. I rate the class material positively but coming to class was a draining experience. I often left the class in despair due to the attitude of the professor. Getting myself to go to this class in particular was draining. Hopefully in the future she is kinder to her students.

This professor is awesome. No quizzes or exams! She says she doesn't believe in this which is awesome. Attendance is mandatory with in class assignments and one group project. Most are participation graces. Definitely take her it's so easy and very interesting. Plus no tests!

This class was super interesting and I definitely learned a lot. We even took a field trip! Dr. Morris is an amazing and kind professor and I loved the dynamic of her lectures. Many assignments were graded for completion and there is a big group project that you work on throughout the semester and present at the end. Overall would highly recommend!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: Professor Morris herself is just the best. She's funny, sweet and so helpful for your success. This class didn't have exams, only in-class participation and projects/essays. She doesnt lecture, only does class activites based on the readings which can be annoying with so many readings. Overall, class isn't hard and mostly completion grades
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: Dr. Morris is great she just tends to go off on her own agendas a lot. She is very personable and wants her students to do well. There are no exams just quick and easy outside of class assignments. The in-class assignments are honestly easy but they are so tedious. You do have to be in class, attendance is weighted heavy. Textbook needed
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: This class was easy. 4 tests (the lowest gets dropped), some in class assignments, and 1 essay are what you get graded by, so there is a lot of extra help in this class grade wise. The tests are 50 multiple choice questions and come straight from her lectures which she gives basically straight from the textbook. She is a very kind and caring prof!
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I took Dr. Morris for SOCI 220. I did not do well in the class because I honestly hate research methods. If you go meet with her during her office hours, she will make sure you are successful in her class. If you go to class, participate, and do well on the paper due at the end of the semester then you will make an A.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: I took professor Morris for 220. She is sweet and understanding. There are textbook readings that are not mandatory but if you want to understand the information definitely do it. You have to put effort in, to get a A. She usually curves the exams even though she says that she won't. She is not teaching 220 nest semester. No extra credit is given.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: She is a good teacher for the most part. She can get preachy at times. You need the textbook because her tests are heavy on stats from the book. You have one paper to do but she grades fairly on them. She likes to do a lot of group work in class but it is not hard. If you study the book and the notes pretty well, easy A.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: Being that I took this my first semester of college, it was way harder than an Intro Soci which I was supposed to take, but wanted to challenge myself for elective. A lot of reading and tests are specific and your only 4 true grades other than your essay. That makes it hard to end with an A if you did bad on the first two, even with her dropping 1.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: She takes attendance for every class but her lectures give you a good idea on what you need to focus on when reading the chapters so go anyway. She's passionate about the subject and enjoys teaching it. There are a few group activities and movies but they're participation grades. Tests were easy and no final. You only have a short paper to write.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Would take again

reviews.comment: She is an amazing professor and very passionate. Lectures mirror the book but have new info so make sure you go to class. She has extra credit opportunities. Do it. Her tests are very specific so know statistics from the book and charts we looked at in class.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Don't take SOCI335 w/her. The only grades for the class are 2 essay exams (midterm/final), 2 papers, and attendance. Ironically, the class is not very organized. She doesn't put anything online (lectures, power points, etc.) other than some of the readings. Lectures are long & boring. This class was way more complicated than necessary.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Absolutely loved taking her class! She expects you to read and expects class participation. There are a couple movie days. There's a lot of assigned reading but she covers the important stuff in class so its good to go even though its not mandatory. Overall easy material and if you know it well the essay exams will be no problem.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Morris was very passionate about this subject, but her lectures were very boring. She expects you to know specifics for the test. She's a tough grader when it comes to essays. I thought this class would be interesting, but her lectures made it very boring and there's a lot of outside reading involved.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Morris is an amazing teacher! Her lectures are awesome and her grading criteria is very clear. You need to show up to class and read your textbook, but if you stay on top of it, unlike me, you will probably get an easy A.

reviews.comment: Super easy A if you pay attention. Lectures are interesting, and there is some reading but would definitely recommend this prof, she is very reasonable and offers a lot of extra credit opportunities and in class participation grades to boost your grade.
